name: WW Biosec — Network Updated
description: Receives network.updated webhooks from ww_api (fired after PUT /v1/network). Logs topology changes to Slack #biosec-ops and optionally triggers a baseline recalibration note.
_notes: This workflow is intentionally minimal. Topology changes should be rare and deliberate.
The Fiedler value drop is a useful signal: a value near 0 means the hypergraph is close to disconnected, which degrades spectral detection.
